title: object-gantt can no longer write back to a same-origin endpoint after #23082 — a measured producer of the retired view-level `api` source (read + write)
body:
**Edition:** ObjectOS Enterprise (licensed, self-managed)
**Version:** 18.2.0 (upgrading from 17.3.0)

## Background

#23082 retired the view-level `api` data source (ruling C, merged in #23160, objectui#12325). The ruling rested partly on a measurement: zero producers of `provider: 'api'` in objectstack, HotCRM and objectui, and no producer of the `write` leg at all. Cloud and customer deployments were not measured.

We are a producer of both legs, in production on 17.3.0. A production-scheduling gantt (a list view of `type: 'gantt'`) was bound like this:

```ts
data: {
  provider: 'api',
  read:  { url: '/api/gantt/tree', method: 'GET' },
  write: { url: '/api/gantt/task', method: 'PATCH' },
},
```

The use already met the rule #23016 set for the page element: both URLs are same-origin relative paths, and the view carries no `headers` and no credential. The console sent its own signed-in fetch.

Why an endpoint and not an object: a server plugin computes the rows when they are read.

- **A four-level tree** (project → product → plan → work order). Project and product are synthetic group rows, so no single object holds the tree.
- **Columns that depend on the caller:** `locked` (only planners may edit; in-progress or archived plans are locked), plus `bar_color`, `border_color` (alert level), `predecessors`, and the tooltip fields. `lockField: 'locked'` is the only way we found to drive the gantt's per-row 🚫 "no edit permission" affordance per user. A view-level `readOnly` is static and cannot vary by user.
- **Writes go through the same endpoint.** It re-checks the role and status gates server-side (403) before it updates the plan. Drag, resize and link all write back in real time, with the gantt's optimistic update and rollback on failure.

`plugin-gantt` documented this shape. Its registered `data` input still says, on `main`: "`{ provider: 'api', read }` reads through that request" (`ui/packages/plugin-gantt/src/index.tsx`, the `object-gantt` registration).

## What happens on 18.2.0 (measured on a local instance)

We tried each replacement. None of them keeps drag write-back to the endpoint.

1. **Page element binding.** `dataSource: { provider: 'api', read: { url: '/api/gantt/tree' }, path: 'data' }` on an `object-gantt` component parses, and the console fetches it. But the value is only exposed as `data` to expression holes and `visibleWhen`. `ElementDataSourceGate` maps only the object binding for the gantt (`OBJECT_GANTT_DATA_SOURCE = { filter, sort }`), so the rows never become gantt records. The binding is also GET-only.
2. **`properties: { staticData: '${data}' }`** to bridge the binding into the records. `os validate` and `os dev` refuse it at compile time: `component-props-invalid … staticData: Invalid input: expected array, received string`. The stack does not start.
3. **A `kind: 'react'` page** that fetches `/api/gantt/tree` and renders `<Block type="object-gantt" staticData={rows} gantt={…} />`.
   - **Reads:** everything renders. The four-level tree, dependency links, shift bands, colors, quick filters, tooltips and the per-row 🚫 from `lockField` all work.
   - **Writes:** a drag moves the bar and even raises the scheduling-conflict dialog, but no request is sent. `staticData` becomes an in-memory `ValueDataSource`, so a reload reverts the change.
   - The page scope offers no way to hand the gantt another `DataSource`, because `ObjectGanttRenderer` takes the adapter from `useSchemaContext()` only. It also offers no `onBeforeTaskUpdate`.
4. **Bind the view to the plan object** (`provider: 'object'`). Drag writes through the generic data API. The tree, the synthetic group rows, the work-order child rows and the per-user computed columns are lost.

So on 18 there is no supported way to build a gantt whose rows come from a server endpoint and whose edits write back to it. The only remaining route is to re-implement the gantt from scratch in a react page.

## Request

Restore an API record source for `object-gantt` (the view `data` arm, or the page component; whichever fits the "one door" principle better), **under the same rule #23016 gives the page element**:

- `read.url` must be same-origin and open with a single `/`, with the same five refusals.
- No `headers`, `credentials`, `auth`, `token` or `apiKey` keys. The console sends its own signed-in fetch.
- `read.method`: `GET` only.

**No new `write` block is needed.** `ApiDataSource` already writes to the read URL when `write` is absent (`ui/packages/core/src/adapters/ApiDataSource.ts`, `update` / `delete`):

```ts
const config = this.writeConfig ?? this.readConfig;
// update → PATCH `${url}/${id}`, delete → DELETE `${url}/${id}`; the method is fixed in code
```

A deployment that serves `PATCH/DELETE /api/gantt/tree/:id` therefore gets write-back with only the `read` leg declared. That is option A of #23082, narrowed to `read`. It adds no credential surface and no cross-origin surface beyond what the page element binding already allows.

Either of these alternatives would also unblock us:

- **(b)** Let the page element's API binding act as `object-gantt`'s record source: rows taken from `path`, writes to `${read.url}/${id}` as above.
- **(c)** A supported write hook that a `kind: 'react'` page can pass to `object-gantt`, such as `onBeforeTaskUpdate` or a host-supplied `DataSource`, so the page can send the write itself.

## Related

- #23082 (ruling C), #23160 (merge `1912af47b`), objectui#12325
- #23016 (page element same-origin / no-credentials rule)
- ADR-0049 (enforce-or-remove)
- Migration entry `view-data-api-provider-retired` (`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.view-data-api-provider-retired.ts`)
